glyph_origin: Pictogram (象形) – a person (人) carrying something. It is often simplified to 㠯 in pre-Qin ancient scripts. Today, the person is partly visible on the right (see also the stylization in 从). See also 重, in which a person is carrying a bag, 央, in which a person is carrying a pole.
senses: [yǐ] a preposition that expresses a boundary in time, orientation, direction or quantity
[yǐ] by; with; by means of; thereby
